Iris (Design): Heads-up — compact request card has corr-id pill, tiny download icon, and hover tooltip all cramped into one tap zone. Mobile users end up downloading when they meant to copy. Anyone else seen this? :grimacing:
Ravi (EngRuntime): Yep, support has flagged accidental downloads. Download triggers a heavy snapshot fetch so we see backend spikes.
Maya (Product): Do we know where most downloads originate? compact card vs detail?
Iris (Design): Quick analytics: ~30% from compact cards last 30 days. Proposal: remove inline download, move it into a kebab menu, make corr-id a single-tap copy with visible keyboard hint (e.g., focus + C).
Lee (Accessibility): Sounds right. Add aria-label to copy control, live region announcement for "Correlation ID copied", and ensure no shortcut conflicts.
Noah (EngPlatform): Implementation: roving tabindex for actions, kebab menu after corr-chip, menu navigable with arrows, Esc closes. I'll add a rate limiter for download initiation.
Ravi (EngRuntime): Backend: for large traces return 202 and provide polling for progress; avoid blocking workers. Add size warning >5MB requiring explicit confirm.
Maya (Product): UX tradeoff — hiding download may affect discoverability. Suggest kebab + subtle hover tooltip in compact view pointing to "More actions". On detail page keep prominent download.
Iris (Design): Two mock variants: A) corr-chip primary copy + kebab menu with "Download trace JSON". B) keep small inline icon but require a 2-step confirm on first click. I'll post mocks.
Lee (Accessibility): Prefer kebab + explicit labels. For menuitems use role=menuitem and aria-haspopup/aria-expanded states. Announce actions via polite live region.
Noah (EngPlatform): I'll own keyboard behavior and NVDA/VoiceOver testing.
Maya (Product): I'll add telemetry: click source (compact vs detail), whether user confirmed, and surface counts to support.
Iris (Design): Plan: finalize mock by EOD and tag @Noah @Ravi. :thumbsup:
